Who We Are

Engineering Reliable Spaces. Building Lasting Trust.

Ahmed Abdul Aziz International Trading & Contracting is a Doha-based construction and engineering company with more than a decade of experience in Qatar. We deliver building construction, MEP works, facility management, and maintenance services for institutional, commercial, and residential clients.

Our experience includes construction, maintenance, and MEP services for Qatar Military College, part of a broader portfolio of residential buildings, villas, housing compounds, office buildings, showrooms, and mixed-use developments.
